title: Uvicorn close path emits KeyboardInterrupt and CancelledError traceback noise
description: Running uvicorn directly without graceful shutdown handling can print noisy stack traces on Ctrl+C or terminal close. The app exits, but operators interpret this as a crash.
detection_method: Regex scan for uvicorn.run usage in Python entrypoints without nearby KeyboardInterrupt handling
preventionRule: Wrap uvicorn.run in try/except KeyboardInterrupt and emit a clean shutdown info message.
remedy: Use a guarded entrypoint: try uvicorn.run(...); except KeyboardInterrupt: print clean shutdown message. Keep lifecycle cleanup idempotent.
